title: Literature-faithful FMC groundwater-front B01 development comparator
purpose: Test the published finite-water-content groundwater-front branch, including capillary relaxation and explicit finite-volume groundwater exchange, against current-canonical R16 and admitted R2 before exercising infiltration/falling-slug branches.

authority.D11: FMC/SMVE selected as next literature-bound comparator
authority.D12: Equation preflight passed with 200 moisture bins and 10 s maximum explicit substep frozen before SWAP trajectories

primary_sources.role: groundwater-front Eq.21, capillary relaxation, finite-volume mass accounting, explicit integration

constitutive_identity.coordinate: z positive downward; H_j positive upward from fixed water table
constitutive_identity.constitutive_sample: right edge of each moisture bin, saturation edge excluded

groundwater_front.baseline_theta: theta_i = theta_r + 0.15*(theta_s-theta_r), identical to the D12 groundwater-equilibrium preflight baseline
groundwater_front.active_bins: j=31..199, i=30 on a 200-bin full-range grid
groundwater_front.capillary_relaxation: after every explicit substep sort H_j from largest to smallest with increasing j; sorting must preserve sum(H_j) to the frozen finite-volume tolerance
groundwater_front.bottom_outward_exchange_cm: -(S_new-S_old) because top exchange is identically zero
groundwater_front.terminal_bottom_outward_flux_cm_per_day: -dtheta*sum_j(dH_j/dt) evaluated on the accepted relaxed state

lambda_histories.role: capillary-fringe retreat toward hydrostatic equilibrium, with H capped at 160 cm before scaling prohibited; only bins whose lambda*psi remain <=160 are admitted

initial_states.G125_admission_rule: If any active bin gives lambda*abs(psi)>160 cm, that bin/history preflight is fail-closed rather than clipped. No alternate lambda is selected after preflight.

matched_SWAP_state.reconstruction: At height y above the lower boundary, theta(y)=theta_i+dtheta*count(H_j>=y).
matched_SWAP_state.cell_average: For every R16 or R2 cell, initialize theta to the exact vertical cell-average of the reconstructed finite-water-content profile, then invert B01 retention for pressure head.
matched_SWAP_state.invariant: Initial total storage must match the FMC finite-volume storage to <=1e-12 cm for both R16 and R2.
matched_SWAP_state.bottom_boundary: zero pressure head at column lower boundary

time_integration.internal_substep_rule: ceil(observation_interval_seconds/10); equal fixed substeps within every observation interval
time_integration.front_integrator: explicit forward Euler as supported by the primary method

checks: all initial front heights finite, positive and <=160 cm without clipping
each one-substep state moves total L1 front-height distance toward hydrostatic equilibrium
capillary relaxation preserves dtheta*sum(H) within 1e-14 cm
finite-volume mass ledger closes within 1e-12 cm
terminal bottom exchange direction is negative for G25/G50/G75 and positive for G125
full_algorithm_preflight.failure_rule: Any failure closes D13 before R16/R2 trajectories are generated. No lambda, bin count, equation or substep retuning is allowed inside D13.

comparators.R16: current-canonical Reference route using the integrated-water-depth research numerical authority already admitted in D4/D10

positive_rule: full-algorithm preflight passes before SWAP evidence
all four matched R16/R2 development histories complete
and FMC beats or equals R2 on both total-storage RMSE and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE
or FMC beats or equals R2 on terminal bottom-flux RMSE with no more bottom-flux sign errors

successor_logic.if_positive: Only then authorize a separate FMC infiltration/falling-slug branch experiment or a broader water-table-coupling comparator.
successor_logic.if_negative: Close FMC as a general hydraulic accelerator candidate for the current B01 route; revisit only under a separately justified application-specific proposition.
successor_logic.if_preflight_fails: Close before SWAP exposure and do not modify the frozen 200-bin/substep/equation identity.
